name: @arcadia-eternity/content-pack-template

scripts.setup: node --input-type=module -e "const p=JSON.parse(await (await import('node:fs/promises')).readFile('arcadia-sdk.json','utf8'));const r=await fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcadia-eternity/arcadia-eternity/'+p.revision+'/packages/content-dev/src/setup.mjs');if(!r.ok)throw Error('Cannot fetch pinned setup: '+r.status);const {setup}=await import('data:text/javascript;base64,'+Buffer.from(await r.text()).toString('base64'));await setup(process.argv.slice(1))" --

description: A runnable Arcadia Eternity user-defined content pack: species, skills, marks and TypeScript effects.
